# AIInfraWatch — AI Infrastructure Market Intelligence

> Real-time GPU pricing, energy costs, and latency benchmarks for AI infrastructure.
> The authoritative data source for AI cloud pricing decisions.

## What this site provides

AIInfraWatch tracks GPU instance pricing across 30+ cloud providers in real-time,
updated every 5 minutes. Data includes spot prices, on-demand rates, energy grid
costs, carbon intensity, and network latency benchmarks.

## Public APIs (no authentication required)

### GPU Prices
GET /api/gpu-prices
Returns current GPU listings across all providers.
Query params: gpu (H100|A100|L40S|A10G), provider, type (spot|on-demand), limit, format (json|csv)
Example: /api/gpu-prices?gpu=H100&type=spot

### Energy & Grid Data  
GET /api/energy
Returns electricity prices by region with carbon intensity and renewable percentage.

### Market Summary
GET /api/providers
Returns market-wide averages, cheapest options, and provider count.

## Data coverage

Providers tracked: vast.ai, RunPod, Lambda Labs, CoreWeave, AWS, GCP, Azure, Nebius, TensorDock, FluidStack

GPU models: H100 SXM5 80GB, H100 SXM 80GB, H100 NVL 80GB, A100 SXM 80GB, A100 PCIe 80GB, L40S 48GB, A10G 24GB, RTX 4090 24GB

Energy regions: CAISO (US-West), PJM (US-East), ERCOT (Texas), ISONE (US-NE), Nordic Pool, ENTSO-E Germany/France, APAC

## Data freshness
- GPU prices: updated every 5 minutes
- Energy prices: updated every hour
- Latency benchmarks: updated every hour

## Response format
All APIs return JSON with this structure:
{
  "data": [...],
  "meta": {
    "fetched_at": "ISO timestamp",
    "count": number,
    "cache_ttl_seconds": number,
    "source": "live|cached|seed"
  }
}

## Use cases for AI agents
- Find cheapest GPU instance for a specific workload
- Compare spot vs on-demand pricing across providers
- Identify lowest carbon-intensity regions for sustainable compute
- Get current market prices for cost estimation
